title: How to spot a fake natty: their training is lazy and yet they grow
summary: NH argues that a reliable sign of a fake natural is a mismatch between a huge physique and objectively lazy training: low tonnage, irrelevant high-rep pump work and little real intensity. Steroids themselves drive growth, and influencers fake hardship through pump and nausea to sell programs.
claims: A big, lean physique paired with unimpressive training is a red flag for PED use
NH got his best results from compound movements, which made the bodybuilder 'no compounds' approach seem suspicious
'Lazy' doesn't mean long rests; it means low intrinsic workout quality in volume, intensity, frequency and tonnage
Enhanced lifters' tonnage is often low and done in irrelevant intensity windows, such as sets of 30-40 reps with baby weights limited by pump or cardio
Steroids themselves constitute tonnage: the injection alone produces growth
The claim that steroids only make you work harder doesn't match what NH sees: enhanced YouTubers' workouts are easy
Pump pain and nausea are not indicators of growth; the flu can make you want to puke
Juicers at NH's old gym were twice his size yet did a few curls and raises then sat around talking
Fake naturals selling programs need you to believe their training, not their drugs, creates their size
If someone denies the importance of programming and progression for naturals, chances are they're not natural
